correctness.rationale: For finite T0 posets, upper neighborhood successor tests show x is free exactly when its strict upper set contains both a selected and an unselected element; all other memberships are fixed by the observed interior/closure. Each mixed successor witnesses a chain to fixed selected and fixed unselected points, making arbitrary free-bit replacement preserve observation. Non-T0 equivalent points give singletons in same fiber but empty intersection outside fiber. Independence on each cube gives conditional entropy h2(p)E|F|, with E|F|=sum_x[1−p^{d_x}−(1−p)^{d_x}] for d_x>=1; subtraction from |P|h2(p) proves stated exact entropy. Independently enumerated every topologically ordered poset n<=5, verifying the Boolean intervals and conditional statistics; not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The entropy formula requires iid Bernoulli-p coordinates and cannot be transferred to dependent samples.
